description: Devin CLI exposes Studio Agent API v1. The sole persisted engine record selects a verified release in the plugin's private engine directory.

managedEngineSelection.description: Selects the currently active managed release. The missing file means no managed selection has been made.

schemaVersion.description: Format version of the managed engine selection.

release.description: A release directory basename inside the managed engine root. Omitted after removal to keep automatic external detection inactive.

managedEngineSelection.description: Private atomic selection of the verified native package active on this Studio host.
